locked_meaning: Construct and evaluate a bounded artefact or workflow.
minimum_evidence_obligation: Artefact behaviour, test evidence and operational boundary
prohibited_conflation: Do not infer production deployment or universal usability.

locked_meaning: Evaluate an algorithm, formal problem or simulation under explicit assumptions.
minimum_evidence_obligation: Reference cases, sensitivity, numerical or algorithmic evidence
prohibited_conflation: Do not reduce the route to successful code execution.

locked_meaning: Evaluate a predictive system against credible baselines and held-out evidence.
minimum_evidence_obligation: Data lineage, baseline, held-out performance, calibration and error analysis
prohibited_conflation: Do not equate model training or one aggregate metric with validity.

locked_meaning: Estimate or compare using an explicit empirical design and uncertainty.
minimum_evidence_obligation: Sampling, estimates, uncertainty, missingness and design boundary
prohibited_conflation: Do not use causal language without a design that supports it.

locked_meaning: Interpret purposively sampled material with an explicit analytic trace and reflexivity.
minimum_evidence_obligation: Sampling logic, analytic trace, reflexivity, negative cases and bounded interpretation
prohibited_conflation: Do not merge the route with case study or claim statistical generalisation.

locked_meaning: Investigate a bounded case through contextual and multiple evidence sources.
minimum_evidence_obligation: Case boundary, multiple sources and chain of evidence
prohibited_conflation: Do not treat one case as a population estimate.

locked_meaning: Use a protocol to identify, resolve, appraise and synthesise studies.
minimum_evidence_obligation: Search and protocol records, publication-to-study identity, appraisal and synthesis
prohibited_conflation: Do not treat record, publication and study as synonyms.

locked_meaning: Integrate named route components at an explicit integration point.
minimum_evidence_obligation: Separate component evidence plus an explicit integration product
prohibited_conflation: Do not use hybrid as a label for an incoherent mixture.
